title: U-47 at Scapa Flow
summary: U-47, commanded by Günther Prien, infiltrated the British base at Scapa Flow and sank the battleship HMS Royal Oak, escaping under heavy pursuit.

title: USS Harder vs. Japanese Destroyers
summary: Commander Samuel Dealey and USS Harder sank five Japanese destroyers in twelve days, becoming one of the most successful US submarine patrols.

title: Shch-303 Baltic Escape
summary: Soviet submarine Shch-303 evaded German patrols and minefields to return to Leningrad, with the crew suffering from cold and exhaustion.

title: HMS Upholder's Final Patrol
summary: Lieutenant Commander Malcolm Wanklyn led HMS Upholder on a daring attack against an Axis convoy before being lost with all hands.

title: I-58 and the Sinking of USS Indianapolis
summary: Japanese submarine I-58 torpedoed and sank USS Indianapolis, leading to one of the worst naval disasters in US history.
